description: Sudden complete loss of circulation while drilling 8-1/2" section into depleted upper Barail sandstone. Annular returns dropped from 560 gpm to 0 gpm within 12 minutes. Pit volume dropped 68 bbls.
rootCause: Sub-hydrostatic pore pressure in depleted Barail sandstone coupled with natural micro-fractures induced breakdown under 10.2 ppg mud hydrostatic overbalance (~420 psi differential).
mitigation: Immediately stopped pumps, pulled off bottom 3 stands, and spotted 45 bbl engineered LCM pill (25 ppb coarse CaCO3 + 15 ppb medium Mica + 5 ppb Walnut shell). Hesitation squeezed at 300 psi until stabilized. Mud weight trimmed to 9.85 ppg.

description: Differential pipe sticking occurred during MWD survey connection. String was left stationary on slips for 35 minutes with 10.4 ppg mud across permeable depleted Barail sand.
rootCause: High differential pressure (approx. 510 psi overbalance) acting across thick filter cake deposited on high-permeability depleted sand during prolonged static survey.
mitigation: Spotted 60 bbl Safe-Solv low toxicity soaking fluid around BHA; jarred downward with hydraulic jar at 80 klb overpull for 4.5 hours until free. Reduced static connection time to < 3 minutes.

description: Severe partial losses escalating to total loss (110 bbl/hr) upon penetrating upper Barail horizon. Loss zone encountered 3 meters into sand package.
rootCause: Extensive tectonic natural fracture network associated with Jorajan boundary fault intersected during drilling with 10.8 ppg mud.
mitigation: Pumped two successive 50 bbl Bentonite-Diesel-Oil (DOB) gunk plugs followed by 40 bbl fiber-flake LCM blend. Waited on plug 6 hours; established full returns at 350 gpm.

description: Gas influx and drilling break detected upon penetrating Kopili transitional sequence. Pit volume gained 22 bbl in 4 minutes; shut-in drillpipe pressure (SIDPP) stabilized at 380 psi.
rootCause: Underbalanced condition caused by unexpected high-pressure lenticular gas sand within Kopili shale sequence. Mud weight of 10.0 ppg was insufficient against 10.7 ppg pore pressure.
mitigation: Closed annular preventer, verified shut-in pressures (SIDPP: 380 psi, SICP: 490 psi), killed well using Wait and Weight method; raised active mud system to 11.2 ppg.

description: Severe stick-slip and torque oscillations up to 26 kft-lb encountered while drilling through fractured coal seam intervals in lower Barail Coal-Shale.
rootCause: Brittle failure of cleated coal seams causing large spalling blocks to jam the bit and PDC cutters.
mitigation: Reduced WOB from 24 klb to 14 klb, increased rotary speed to 110 RPM, added 3% liquid drilling torque reducer lubricant to active system.

description: High pressure gas and condensate kick while coring Kopili deep section. SIDPP rose to 620 psi with 35 bbl pit gain.
rootCause: Overpressured reservoir pocket trapped against sealing fault; mud weight (11.5 ppg) fell below formation pore pressure equivalent (12.4 ppg).
mitigation: Executed Driller's Method circulating out kick through choke manifold; weighted up mud system to 12.6 ppg with barite.

description: Seepage losses of 35 bbl/hr starting at 2842m in Barail sand top, gradually increasing with ECD.
rootCause: Excess dynamic ECD (10.6 ppg equivalent) fracturing low-strength depleted sand boundary.
mitigation: Reduced pump rate from 540 to 440 gpm to lower annular pressure drop; swept hole with 30 bbl fine CaCO3 (15 ppb) pill; losses sealed completely.

description: Mechanical pack-off and pipe drag during trip-out of hole across upper Barail boundary.
rootCause: Sloughed coal and shale fragments from Barail coal sequence accumulated around top stabilizers during wiper trip.
mitigation: Circulated high-viscosity bentonite sweep at 480 gpm; worked string with full pump pressure until debris cleared; backreamed interval twice.

description: Premature slurry flash set and high pump pressure during 9-5/8" casing cement job. Top of cement (TOC) tagged 320m below programmed design.
rootCause: Incompatible cement retarder dosage for downhole BHT (88°C) combined with high water loss into micro-fractured sandy streaks.
mitigation: Ran CBL/VDL log to determine cement top; performed remedial squeeze cementing through perforations at 2260m; successfully tested to 1500 psi.

description: Loss of 45 bbls of mud upon drilling into Barail depleted sand top with 10.3 ppg mud.
rootCause: Overbalanced pressure differential exceeding formation matrix sealing capacity.
mitigation: Pumped 35 bbl engineered LCM pill containing medium cellulose fiber and calcium carbonate. Reduced flow rate to 460 gpm.
